items.name: Page's Ribbon
items.lore: A faded blue ribbon, tied round a lock of hair.

items.name: Ring of the Faithful Page
items.lore: A boy's ring, too small for most fingers. It fits yours.

items.name: Aldric's Broken Spur
items.lore: A knight's spur, snapped. He ran.

items.name: Sealed-Letter Sash
items.lore: Blue silk embroidered with a page's careful letters.

items.name: Lethantis Brand-Ring
items.lore: An iron ring with the Association's mark. Taken from a dead man who meant to kill an old one.

items.name: Heretic's Satchel
items.lore: A hermit's scrip, full of notes in a tiny hand.

items.name: Ogre-Hide Wrap
items.lore: Rough green hide. An ogre wore it before you; a Lethantis mage made the ogre.

items.name: Seeker's Bracer
items.lore: Light, quiet, and made for following people.
